articles.title: Log Noise Collapser
articles.hook: Paste a log dump, get back the handful of distinct failures underneath it. The embedding model runs in your browser tab, so no key, no upload, no quota.
articles.how_free: Inference runs client-side via Transformers.js (Apache-2.0) on the visitor's own CPU/GPU, so there is no API and no per-request quota. The only network cost is a one-time ~22 MB model download (Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2, q8 ONNX) from the Hugging Face Hub, which is free and rate-limited for anonymous users to 3,000 file-resolve requests per 5-minute window per IP; the browser caches the weights afterwards.
produces: clustered log groups with counts, masked templates, severity level and example lines
markdown summary of the distinct failures
accepts: pasted, typed or dropped raw log text (.log, .txt, .json, .ndjson), up to 20,000 lines
